lines.en: label beachfive3:
scene sky

It’s Friday morning and, as previously agreed upon, I’m currently on my way to the Amamiya mansion to listen to whatever it is Ayane has to say regarding the state of our world and how immeasurably fucked up it is.
lines.zh: 今天是周五早上，按照先前的约定，我正前往 Amamiya 宅邸，去听听 Ayane 要说些什么——关于我们这个世界的现状，以及它究竟烂得有多无可救药。

lines.en: Granted, I’m sure a lot of it will just be me dejectedly agreeing to whatever she proposes since I really don’t care anymore...but maybe Makoto will miraculously start caring in my stead and balance her out?
lines.zh: 当然，我敢肯定大部分时间我只会沮丧地对她的提议点头称是，因为我已经真的不在乎了……但也许 Makoto 会奇迹般地替我在乎起来，跟她形成平衡？

lines.en: Which is doubtful (as everything is doubtful) considering that Ayane has specifically informed me of just how little she seems to care, but there are crazier things that have happened.
lines.zh: 不过这很值得怀疑（反正一切都值得怀疑），毕竟 Ayane 特意告诉过我 Makoto 看起来有多么不在乎，但比这更离谱的事也发生过。

lines.en: Like, for example, have I ever told you about the time I was having sex with Maya on the roof only to have her disappear partway through? Because {i}that{/i} was crazy, wasn’t it? Way crazier than whatever this is.
lines.zh: 比如说，我有没有跟你们讲过那次我在天台上和 Maya 做爱，结果她中途就消失了？{i}那{/i}才叫离谱，不是吗？比眼下这事儿离谱多了。

lines.en: So yeah, today is going to be a day. And it will be a day that I do my best to not phone-in out of respect for the one girl I know who is doing a better job of keeping it together than everyone else combined.
lines.zh: 所以，没错，今天会是「一天」。而这一天我会尽量不敷衍了事，算是尊重我认识的那个、比所有人加起来都更能撑住场面的女孩。

lines.en: scene black
So cheers to you, Ayane Amamiya — may your morning be full of joy and squandered opportunities to abandon a man who does not deserve you.
lines.zh: 那么敬你一杯，Ayane Amamiya —— 愿你的清晨充满喜悦，也充满错失抛弃一个配不上你的男人的大好机会。

lines.en: scene ayanepresentation1
: Lady and gentleman, I present to you...my foolproof plan to save the world and marry Sensei! Please be advised that the real title is still in progress and that this one is just a placeholder.
lines.zh: : 女士们先生们，请允许我向你们呈上……我那万无一失的拯救世界并嫁给 Sensei 的计划！温馨提示，真正的标题还在构思中，这个只是占位符。

lines.en: scene ayanepresentation2
: Did you really have to make shirts for us?
lines.zh: : 你真的非得给我们做T恤吗？

lines.en: : Did you really have to wear one?
lines.zh: : 你真的非得穿上吗？

lines.en: scene ayanepresentation3
: I wasn’t going to. But it looks good on me, doesn’t it?
lines.zh: : 我本来不打算穿的。不过我穿着挺好看的，对吧？

lines.en: : Yeah. Where are your glasses, though?
lines.zh: : 是啊。不过你眼镜呢？

lines.en: scene ayanepresentation4
: I’m actually wearing {i}contacts{/i} today. Cool, right? And it only took me half an hour to put them in.
lines.zh: : 我今天其实戴了{i}隐形眼镜{/i}。很酷吧？而且我只花了半小时就戴上了。

lines.en: : I feel like that is significantly longer than such a thing is supposed to take.
lines.zh: : 我觉得这比正常情况下该花的时间长太多了。

lines.en: : Hey! Stop flirting and pay attention to my plan to restore the world and everyone in it to the proper state!
lines.zh: : 喂！别打情骂俏了，专心听我把世界和世上所有人恢复正轨的计划！

lines.en: scene ayanepresentation5
: Sorry, Ayane. It’s been a while since I’ve hung out with Makoto and I’ve forgotten the level of rude that I am supposed to be with her.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，Ayane。我很久没和 Makoto 一起玩了，都忘了跟她该保持多毒舌的程度。

lines.en: : Zero rude. You decided to be nice to me, remember? I think I’d actually prefer it if you’d bring that up to a four or five, though. It feels weird when you’re too nice.
lines.zh: : 零毒舌。你决定要对我好一点的，记得吗？不过我觉得你要是能把它提升到四五分就更好了。你太温柔的时候感觉很奇怪。

lines.en: : Shut up, Ayane is talking.
lines.zh: : 闭嘴，Ayane 在说话。

lines.en: : Yeah, like that. That’s a good level.
lines.zh: : 对，就这样。这个程度刚刚好。

lines.en: : Are you two done now?
lines.zh: : 你们俩闹完了吗？

lines.en: : Yeah, sorry.
lines.zh: : 嗯，抱歉。

lines.en: scene ayanepresentation6
: Good! Then, let me begin by thanking both of you for coming and saying that I greatly appreciate you humoring me as my mind continues to be thrown into turmoil on a day-to-day basis!
lines.zh: : 很好！那么首先，感谢你们二位今天能来，也非常感激你们愿意在我日复一日陷入混乱时还陪着我胡闹！

lines.en: : Amen.
lines.zh: : 阿门。

lines.en: scene ayanepresentation7

: Now, as you {i}may{/i} already know, things have happened that have caused our world to reset near the end of every school year. What {i}are{/i} these things, you ask? No clue! But what we {i}do{/i} know is that it sucks!
lines.zh: : 那么，正如你们{i}可能{/i}已经知道的，发生了一些事，导致我们的世界在每个学年临近结束时都会重置。你们问这些事{i}是{/i}什么？毫无头绪！但我们{i}知道{/i}的是——这烂透了！

lines.en: : Do I need to raise my hand to disagree or can I just verbally do that right now?
lines.zh: : 我需要举手表示反对，还是现在直接口头反对就行了？

lines.en: : I think you just kind of did.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你刚刚就已经做了。

lines.en: scene ayanepresentation8
: I continue to be surprised by just how okay with this you are when all it does is prevent you from ever achieving the future you’ve been working toward your entire life.
lines.zh: : 我一直很惊讶你居然能这么泰然处之，毕竟这件事唯一的作用就是让你永远无法实现你毕生努力追求的那个未来。

lines.en: : I continue to be surprised by just how {i}not{/i} okay with this you are when all this does is allow you to indefinitely have sex with a rapidly multiplying number of teenagers for the rest of eternity.
lines.zh: : 我也一直很惊讶你居然这么{i}无法{/i}接受，毕竟这件事唯一的作用，就是让你能在无尽的时间里，和数量急速膨胀的少女们一直做爱下去。

lines.en: : And I continue to be ignored! Pay attention! I worked hard on this!
lines.zh: : 而我继续被无视！专心点！这可是我费了很大劲做出来的！

lines.en: scene ayanepresentation9
: Sorry. But let the record show that I am right. And also that I think it would be okay if we’d take it a little easier in trying to uncover the secrets of a thing that defies all logic and science.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。但请记录在案：我是对的。另外，我觉得我们在试图揭开一个违背一切逻辑与科学的东西的秘密时，可以稍微放松一点。

lines.en: : Let the record also show that I have a photo of Makoto sucking a dildo backed up on my computer.
lines.zh: : 也请记录在案：我电脑里备份着一张 Makoto 舔假阳具的照片。

lines.en: : Permission to strike the record, madam speaker?
lines.zh: : 议长女士，能否申请删除该记录？

lines.en: scene ayanepresentation10
: Granted. Now, back to the topic at hand.
lines.zh: : 批准。现在，回到正题。

lines.en: scene ayanepresentation11

: Right now, only {i}three{/i} of us are aware of the state of the world: me, Sensei, and Makoto. And with Maya’s memories purged, we have no evidence that {i}more{/i} than three people can safely know at any given time.
lines.zh: : 目前只有我们{i}三个人{/i}知晓世界的状况：我、Sensei 和 Makoto。而在 Maya 的记忆被清除之后，我们没有证据表明在任何时候能有{i}超过{/i}三个人安全地知道这件事。

lines.en: scene ayanepresentation12
: There have been instances in the past where that number has increased, but {i}no{/i} evidence of such information carrying over from one timeline to the next as a value {i}greater{/i} than three.
lines.zh: : 过去确实出现过这个数字增加的情况，但{i}没有{/i}证据表明这类信息能以{i}大于{/i}三的数量从一条时间线延续到下一条。

lines.en: : {i}Additionally,{/i} we’ve never had more than three people on the rooftop at once.
lines.zh: : {i}此外，{/i}我们也从未有过超过三个人同时出现在天台上。

lines.en: : And while this is in no way {i}proof{/i} that such a thing is impossible, what it {i}does{/i} do is provide a precedent and warning in regard to how we proceed from here.
lines.zh: : 虽然这绝不能{i}证明{/i}那种情况不可能发生，但它{i}确实{/i}为我们接下来该如何行动提供了先例和警示。

lines.en: scene ayanepresentation13
: What that means is even {i}if{/i} we find someone with the ability to {i}retain{/i} information about the loops, we have no guarantee that they’ll remember it once the next cycle begins...
lines.zh: : 这意味着，{i}即便{/i}我们找到了有能力{i}保留{/i}循环相关信息的人，也无法保证他们在下一轮循环开始后还记得……

lines.en: : It also seems so far that this information is stored in a sort of...seniority-focused way. Maya was the first to know, followed by Sensei, then me, then Makoto.
lines.zh: : 目前看来，这些信息还以某种……论资排辈的方式储存着。Maya 是第一个知道的，接着是 Sensei，然后是我，再然后是 Makoto。

lines.en: : Once {i}Makoto{/i} started retaining information and making it to the roof, Maya {i}lost{/i} that ability. Which would mean, if that’s an indication of things to come, {i}Sensei{/i} would be the next to go back to “normal.”
lines.zh: : 一旦 {i}Makoto{/i} 开始保留信息并登上天台，Maya 就{i}失去了{/i}这个能力。这意味着，如果这是未来的预兆，{i}Sensei{/i} 就会是下一个回到「正常」状态的人。

lines.en: : Objection. I’d like to strike that from the record as well so Sensei doesn’t start blaming {i}me{/i} for the disappearance of his beloved Maya.
lines.zh: : 反对。我也想申请把这段从记录里删掉，免得 Sensei 开始把他心爱 Maya 的消失怪到{i}我{/i}头上。

lines.en: : Denied. I’m not doing this to try and point fingers at anyone, I’m just saying that we need to be aware of the risks involved if we {i}do{/i} start trying to tell other people about this.
lines.zh: : 驳回。我说这些不是为了指责任何人，我只是说如果我们{i}真的{/i}开始把这件事告诉别人，就必须清楚其中的风险。

lines.en: scene ayanepresentation14
: It’s very possible that none of this is relevant at all. I just think it would be best if we didn’t get our hopes up since all that’s done in the past is let us down.
lines.zh: : 很有可能这一切根本无关紧要。我只是觉得我们最好不要抱太大希望，因为希望过去带给我们的只有失望。

lines.en: : As such, I think we need to accept that {i}any one of us{/i} could be “gone” at any given moment. And, should that happen again, we can’t let ourselves fall into the state Sensei did after Maya.
lines.zh: : 因此，我认为我们需要接受：{i}我们中的任何人{/i}都可能在任何时刻「消失」。而如果这种事再次发生，我们绝不能让自己陷入 Sensei 在 Maya 之后的那副模样。

lines.en: : Our time is only infinite to a certain degree. And what we learned through Maya’s disappearance is that we need to cherish each and every single day we have together because we never know when our days will end.
lines.zh: : 我们的时间只是在某种程度上是无限的。而 Maya 的消失教会我们的是：必须珍惜在一起的每一天，因为我们永远不知道哪一天就是尽头。

lines.en: scene ayanepresentation15
: Understood?
lines.zh: : 明白了吗？

lines.en: scene ayanepresentation16
: I’m sorry...to both of you. I wasn’t really thinking of that...I just didn’t know how to get out of bed.
lines.zh: : 对不起……对你们两个都是。我真的没想那么多……我只是不知道该怎么从床上爬起来。

lines.en: : Way to go, Ayane. Your morbid message of “hope” has made Sensei upset.
lines.zh: : 干得漂亮，Ayane。你那充满「希望」的病态发言把 Sensei 弄难受了。

lines.en: : Sensei, you don’t have to apologize! I know exactly how hard this has been for you. But the reason we need to be careful about stuff like this is because we want to {i}prevent{/i} it from happening again.
lines.zh: : Sensei，你不用道歉！我非常清楚你有多难熬。但我们之所以需要在这种事上格外谨慎，就是因为我们想{i}阻止{/i}它再次发生。

lines.en: : So let this presentation be {i}my{/i} promise that if you {i}do{/i} vanish, I’ll keep working hard until I get you back. We’ve gotta keep the ball rolling or we’ll never get anywhere. Do you understand?
lines.zh: : 所以就让这次演讲成为{i}我的{/i}承诺：如果你{i}真的{/i}消失了，我会一直努力，直到把你找回来。我们必须让这颗球继续滚下去，否则永远到不了任何地方。你明白吗？

lines.en: scene ayanepresentation17
: If this theory {i}is{/i} true, though — this one based on “seniority,” we only have to experience it once more before pulling the plug on informing others, correct?
lines.zh: : 不过如果这个理论{i}是{/i}真的——这个基于「论资排辈」的理论，我们只需要再经历一次，就能彻底放弃告知他人这件事，对吧？

lines.en: : Because Sensei being reset after one more {i}new{/i} person makes it to the roof would establish a definitive pattern.
lines.zh: : 因为如果再有下一个{i}新{/i}人登上天台之后 Sensei 就被重置，那就足以确立一个明确的规律。

lines.en: : And repeatedly cycling through three people over and over won’t give anyone a long enough time to really {i}investigate{/i} anything. Right?
lines.zh: : 而一直在这三个人之间反复循环，谁都不可能有足够长的时间去真正{i}调查{/i}任何事。对吧？

lines.en: scene ayanepresentation18

: Right. Which is why I propose that we come up with a list of people who we think are both {i}capable{/i} of maintaining a level head in the face of an apocalypse, as well as those we think are {i}able{/i} to.
lines.zh: : 没错。所以我提议，我们来列一份名单，收录那些我们认为在末日面前{i}能{/i}保持冷静、也{i}有能力{/i}承受这件事的人。

lines.en: scene ayanepresentation19

: We already know that Maya, Yumi, and Tsuneyo are capable of {i}knowing{/i} about the loops, but that’s the extent of our knowledge. And since I like to believe in everyone, I think they’d be able to remain strong.
lines.zh: : 我们已经知道 Maya、Yumi 和 Tsuneyo 有能力承受关于循环的{i}知识{/i}，但我们的了解也就到此为止了。而我向来愿意相信所有人，所以我认为她们也能保持坚强。

lines.en: : I’ve also included Miku and Sana in this list because of their respective connections to Makoto and I — and Nodoka and Noriko because they’re both really smart.
lines.zh: : 我还把 Miku 和 Sana 列入了名单，因为她们分别与 Makoto 和我有所关联——至于 Nodoka 和 Noriko，是因为她们都很聪明。

lines.en: : I’m sure Noriko’s connection to Sensei counts for something as well. So if we’re going to tell {i}anybody,{/i} I think these are the ones we need to stick to.
lines.zh: : 我相信 Noriko 和 Sensei 之间的关系也算得上加分项。所以如果要告诉{i}谁{/i}，我认为就该限定在这些人里。

lines.en: : You can go ahead and just remove Miku from that list now. I love her with all of my heart, but there’s no way she’d ever be able to comprehend any of this. And I know that for a fact because I’ve already tried.
lines.zh: : 你现在就可以直接把 Miku 从名单上划掉了。我全心全意爱她，但她绝对不可能理解这些事。而且我敢打包票，因为我已经试过了。

lines.en: : Actually...I’m glad you included Noriko on there. Because something she said the other day really got me thinking.
lines.zh: : 其实……我很高兴你把 Noriko 也列进去了。因为她前几天说的话真的让我开始思考。

lines.en: scene ayanepresentation20
: You guys already know that my memories got pretty messed up somewhere within the fifty-billion timelines we must’ve experienced, but they’ve been coming back little by little.
lines.zh: : 你们已经知道，在我们必然经历过的那五百亿条时间线中的某处，我的记忆变得相当混乱，但它们正在一点一点地回来。

lines.en: : Noriko mentioned that Maya might be in the same boat. Maybe {i}her{/i} memories are just...locked away somewhere? Maybe something just needs to sort of...trigger them and remind her?
lines.zh: : Noriko 提到 Maya 可能也是同样的状况。也许{i}她{/i}的记忆只是……被锁在了某个地方？也许只需要某种东西……触发它们、提醒她？

lines.en: : With all due respect, Sensei, we don’t know for sure {i}what{/i} caused your memories to fade. I’d argue that the effects of trauma are significantly more plausible than...timeline interference.
lines.zh: : 恕我直言，Sensei，我们并不确定是{i}什么{/i}导致你的记忆消退。我认为创伤的影响远比……时间线干涉要合理得多。

lines.en: scene ayanepresentation21
: And I won’t argue against that. But if I need to be positive right now, I’m going to regurgitate the only bit of hope I’ve gotten since she vanished. And right now, that’s what I have.
lines.zh: : 这点我不会反驳。但如果我现在必须乐观一点，那我就只能把她消失后得到的那唯一一点希望翻来覆去地咀嚼。而眼下，我只有这个。

lines.en: : Maybe I’m wrong. In fact, I’m {i}probably{/i} wrong.
lines.zh: : 也许我错了。事实上，我{i}大概{/i}就是错的。

lines.en: : But, at the very least, it shows that Noriko is capable of picking up the differences in Maya’s behavior- and that seems to be something everyone else has struggled with.
lines.zh: : 但至少，这说明 Noriko 有能力察觉 Maya 行为上的异常——而这似乎是其他所有人都做不到的事。

lines.en: : That’s actually another reason I included her.
lines.zh: : 这其实也是我把她列进去的另一个原因。

lines.en: scene ayanepresentation22
: Noriko told me about the talk you guys had and how you told her to come to me. That’s when I really started trying to throw this plan together.
lines.zh: : Noriko 跟我说了你们那次谈话，也说你让她来找我。就是从那时起，我才真正开始着手拼凑这个计划。

lines.en: : Well, what {i}is{/i} the plan in the first place? Because I’m not sure if I’d call just doomsaying to all of our friends a concrete strategy.
lines.zh: : 话说回来，这个计划到底{i}是{/i}什么？因为我不确定「对着所有朋友散播末日言论」能不能算一个具体策略。

lines.en: : I’ll get to that in a second. I have to do more doomsaying first.
lines.zh: : 我马上就说到。不过在那之前我得先再散播一会儿末日言论。

lines.en: scene ayanepresentation23
: It’s been over six months since our last apocalypse.
lines.zh: : 距离上一次末日已经过去六个多月了。

lines.en: : And while I’ve yet to catch onto whatever sort of vibes Maya used to pick up on that made her aware of their approach, I imagine we’re getting close to another based on the time-frame alone.
lines.zh: : 虽然我还没能捕捉到 Maya 过去用来察觉它们临近的那种感觉，但光看时间间隔，我想我们离下一次已经很近了。

lines.en: : Taking that into consideration and measuring it against the {i}other{/i} apocalypses I’ve gone through, I can only assume the next one might happen any day now.
lines.zh: : 把这点纳入考量，再对照我经历过的{i}其他{/i}几次末日，我只能假定下一次随时可能发生。

lines.en: scene ayanepresentation24
: And that means we need to act sooner rather than later if we want to make any progress this time around.
lines.zh: : 而这意味着，如果我们想在这一轮里取得任何进展，就必须尽早行动。

lines.en: : Sensei, you’re probably not aware of this since you and Ami have both been away from school for a while, but our next beach trip is tomorrow. And I want you to come. But I want you to come {i}without{/i} Ami.
lines.zh: : Sensei，你大概还{i}不{/i}知道，因为你和 Ami 都离开学校有一阵子了——我们下一次海边旅行就在明天。我希望你来。但我希望你是撇下 Ami 一个人来。

lines.en: : That’s...probably a little easier said than done.
lines.zh: : 这……大概是说起来容易做起来难。

lines.en: : I’m sure you’ll figure it out. And, in the event that you’re uncomfortable being around the entire class at once again, don’t be. Because I’m already working on a plan for that as well.
lines.zh: : 我相信你会想到办法的。而且，如果再次和全班同学待在一起让你不舒服，别担心。因为这件事我也已经在想办法了。

lines.en: : Question — why does it need to be during the beach trip? Do these apocalypses {i}always{/i} occur during class gatherings, or-
lines.zh: : 提问——为什么非得是海边旅行的时候？这些末日{i}总是{/i}发生在全班聚会上吗，还是说——

lines.en: scene ayanepresentation25
: I’m glad you asked, Makoto! Because this is where phase one of my foolproof plan comes into play!
lines.zh: : 很高兴你问这个问题，Makoto！因为我的万无一失计划的第一阶段就在这里登场！

lines.en: : We are but young girls, oblivious to the ways of the world! But what we {i}do{/i} know is how to create a vast network of information and different methods of exchanging it! And the best method of all, you ask?
lines.zh: : 我们不过是无知于世间运作方式的少女罢了！但我们{i}懂得{/i}的，是如何编织一张庞大的情报网，以及交换情报的种种手段！而其中最棒的手段，你问是什么？

lines.en: scene ayanepresentation26
: We throw a slumber party!
lines.zh: : 办一场睡衣派对！

lines.en: scene ayanepresentation27
: That’s phase one of your plan to “save the world?” A slumber party?
lines.zh: : 这就是你「拯救世界」计划的第一阶段？一场睡衣派对？

lines.en: : Not just {i}any{/i} slumber party! A beach slumber party in Sensei’s room at the inn! Super secret and invite-only, just like the {i}last{/i} time we did this.
lines.zh: : 可不是{i}普通{/i}的睡衣派对！是在旅馆里 Sensei 房间办的海边睡衣派对！超级机密、仅限受邀者参加，就像{i}上次{/i}我们做的那样。

lines.en: : You’ve used this method before?
lines.zh: : 你以前用过这招？

lines.en: : Yes and, if I’m remembering correctly, it immediately invoked an apocalypse.
lines.zh: : 用过，而且如果我没记错的话，它当场就招来了一次末日。

lines.en: : That it did, Sensei. Which means it’s very possible that it happens again.
lines.zh: : 没错，Sensei。也就是说，它很有可能再次发生。

lines.en: : Sure. But last time, I had a little more of an opportunity to get Yumi and Tsuneyo to agree. I have no idea how I’d manage that on such short notice this time.
lines.zh: : 好吧。但上一次，我有更多余裕去说服 Yumi 和 Tsuneyo 点头。这次时间这么紧，我真不知道该怎么办到。

lines.en: : Leave all of that to me, Sensei! You just worry about a way to keep Ami at home and make it so {i}you{/i} can come to the party without her. Because I love Ami, but all she’d do here is get in the way.
lines.zh: : 这些全都交给我吧，Sensei！你只需要想办法把 Ami 留在家里，好让你能不带她一个人{i}来{/i}参加派对。因为我爱 Ami，但她在这里只会碍事。

lines.en: : And what do {i}I{/i} do?
lines.zh: : 那{i}我{/i}做什么？

lines.en: : Just show up, I guess. I didn’t really factor you into the equation since I wasn’t positive you were even going to make it here today.
lines.zh: : 我猜……你露面就行。我其实没把你算进方程式里，因为我不确定你今天到底会不会来。

lines.en: scene ayanepresentation28
: Yeah, I probably wouldn’t have if you didn’t show up at my house with your butler.
lines.zh: : 是啊，要是你没带着管家找上我家，我大概就不会来了。

lines.en: : So...I just worry about getting to the beach alone-
lines.zh: : 所以……我只需要想办法一个人到海边——

lines.en: : And we throw a midnight bash where we poke and prod at our classmates’ minds with apocalyptic info to see if anything sticks!
lines.zh: : 然后我们办一场午夜狂欢，用末日情报去戳弄试探同学们的脑子，看看有没有什么能留下！

lines.en: : It’s not foolproof by any means. But we’re running out of time, and it’s way easier to get everyone together when we’re already...you know...{i}together.{/i}
lines.zh: : 这绝对算不上万无一失。但我们时间不多了，而且当我们本来就……你懂的……聚{i}在一起{/i}的时候，把所有人召集起来要容易得多。

lines.en: : If that’s...what you think is best.
lines.zh: : 如果……你觉得这样是最好的话。

lines.en: scene ayanepresentation29

: How do {i}you{/i} feel, though? Are you really ready to start doing things like this again? Because I was under the impression you were trying to just...remove yourself from the class atmosphere altogether.
lines.zh: : 不过你{i}自己{/i}感觉怎么样？你真的准备好重新开始做这种事了吗？因为我的印象里，你一直想……彻底从班级的氛围里抽身。

lines.en: : Frankly? I’m not ready. And I’m not looking forward to it at all.
lines.zh: : 说实话？我没准备好。而且我一点也不期待。

lines.en: scene ayanepresentation30
: But I trust Ayane...so I’m going to put all my faith in her since I have nowhere else to put it now.
lines.zh: : 但我信任 Ayane……所以我要把全部信念都寄托在她身上，毕竟我已经无处可寄托了。

lines.en: scene ayanepresentation31
: Thank you, Sensei...
lines.zh: : 谢谢你，Sensei……

lines.en: : I know I’m no Maya, but I’m going to do my best.
lines.zh: : 我知道我不如 Maya，但我会全力以赴。

lines.en: scene ayanepresentation32
: And honestly? Doing my best is way easier when she’s not here to doubt me all the time. Like seriously, what the fuck was that about?
lines.zh: : 而且说实话？她不在这儿一直质疑我的时候，全力以赴要容易多了。说真的，她那副态度到底算什么？

lines.en: : I mean, if {i}I{/i} was an immortal time-traveler, which I guess I kind of...{i}am{/i} now?...I’d doubt you too if your first plan was throwing a slumber party.
lines.zh: : 我是说，如果{i}我{/i}是个不老不死的时间旅行者——话说我好像现在……{i}算是{/i}了？……如果你的第一个计划是办睡衣派对，我也会怀疑你的。

lines.en: : The slumber party method has worked 100%% of the time. Kind of. It’s foolproof. Mostly.
lines.zh: : 睡衣派对这个法子的成功率是 100%%。大概。它万无一失。基本吧。

lines.en: : Also, it’ll be fun sneaking into Sensei’s bed while everyone else is asleep and reclaiming his body as mine.
lines.zh: : 而且，等其他人都睡着以后偷偷溜进 Sensei 的被窝，把他的身体重新占为己有，会很有意思的。

lines.en: scene black
: Note to self — wear earplugs to bed.
lines.zh: : 备忘——睡觉时戴耳塞。

lines.en: : Earplugs will be provided to all attendees free-of-charge! Except Sensei. I want him to {i}hear{/i} me.
lines.zh: : 所有参加者都将免费获得耳塞！Sensei 除外。我要他{i}听见{/i}我。

lines.en: : Okay. I’m going to head home now if that’s all we’re doing today.
lines.zh: : 好吧。如果今天就这些，我现在要回家了。

lines.en: : Wait, Dad-
lines.zh: : 等等，爸爸——

lines.en: : {i}Dad?{/i}
: Don’t worry, I’ve got a plan for Ami. Just call me tomorrow when the coast is clear for me to head over.
lines.zh: : 别担心，我对 Ami 有安排。明天等风头过去，再打电话叫我就行。

lines.en: : Got it. I love you! Makoto, do you need a ride? Geoffrey’s probably in his cryo-chamber right now, but I can page him if you-
lines.zh: : 明白了。我爱你！Makoto，需要我送你吗？Geoffrey 这会儿大概正泡在他的冷冻舱里，不过我可以呼叫他，如果你——

lines.en: : I’ll walk home with Sensei, it’s fine.
lines.zh: : 我和 Sensei 一起走回去就好，没事的。

lines.en: : I’d rather be alone right now, actually. But I’ll see you tomorrow night, Makoto.
lines.zh: : 其实我现在更想一个人待着。不过明晚见，Makoto。

lines.en: : Ugh...fine. Also, cryo-chamber?
lines.zh: : 呃……行吧。话说，冷冻舱？

lines.en: : Oh, yeah. Geoffrey is actually-
lines.zh: : 哦，对。Geoffrey 其实是——

lines.en: I leave the Amamiya mansion and...try to snap myself into whatever state of mind will allow me to pretend things are normal again.
lines.zh: 我离开 Amamiya 宅邸，然后……试着把自己调整回那种能假装一切如常的心境。

lines.en: scene nightsky
I spend the rest of the day by Ami’s side.
lines.zh: 接下来的一整天我都待在 Ami 身边。

lines.en: It’s the least I can do since I’ll be leaving her tomorrow.
lines.zh: 既然明天我就要离开她，这已是我能做到的最低限度。

lines.en: But it’ll also be a good opportunity.
lines.zh: 但这也会是个好机会。

lines.en: Not for me, but for her.
lines.zh: 不是对我而言，而是对她。

lines.en: And for the girl who volunteered to stay by her side.
lines.zh: 以及对那个自愿留在她身边的女孩而言。

lines.en: scene black
I think I’ll be ready to have a talk soon.
lines.zh: 我想我很快就能准备好谈一谈了。
